music.title: The Artist
music.heroDescription: Taiga Trece is a freelance rapper and artist who combines artistic methods with coaching and somatic experience. Through music, workshops, and personal development, she creates innovative spaces for creative expression and empowerment.
music.aboutText: As a founding member of the 5Elements Collective, Taiga develops projects that strengthen young people in artistic contexts. Her approach integrates creativity with personal growth, using rap and artistic expression as tools for identity development and self-empowerment.
music.latestDescription: Explore Taiga's musical journey through her latest releases, collaborations, and artistic projects.
music.contactDescription: Follow Taiga's musical journey and stay updated with new releases, performances, and artistic collaborations.

workshops.title: Workshops & Coaching
workshops.heroDescription: Taiga Trece combines artistic methods with coaching and somatic experience. Creating innovative learning spaces where creative expression, empowerment, and personal development take center stage through self-experience, resilience, and growth – individually or in teams.
workshops.contactDescription: Interested in booking a workshop or coaching session? Taiga works with cultural institutions, educational providers, companies, and individuals. Contact to discuss your specific needs and create a customized program.

rapSongwriting.title: Rap & Songwriting
rapSongwriting.description: Find your voice, write authentic texts, and develop your performance skills. Learn to express yourself through rap as a creative tool for identity and self-expression.

femaleEmpowerment.title: Female Empowerment & FLINTA*
femaleEmpowerment.description: Develop visibility, presence, self-confidence, and resilience. Safe spaces for women and FLINTA* persons to explore potential and strengthen authentic self-expression.

deutschRap.title: Deutsch lernen mit Rap
deutschRap.description: Experience language learning in a lively, creative, and playful way. Use rap and rhythm to improve German language skills and cultural understanding through music.

selfAwareness.title: Selbstwahrnehmung & Präsenz
selfAwareness.description: Authentic presence, clear communication, and understanding impact. Develop self-awareness and learn how to present yourself confidently in personal and professional contexts.

femaleHealth.title: Female Health & Embodiment
femaleHealth.description: Explore femininity, learn to set boundaries, and experience somatic practices. Integrative approach combining body awareness with personal empowerment and healing.

rapYoga.title: Rap-Yoga
rapYoga.description: Use identity as a resource and rap as a tool. Explore ambivalences and find solutions through the unique combination of movement, breath, and creative expression.

professionalBackground.title: Professional Background
professionalBackground.description: Freelance rapper and artist, educational consultant, systemic coach, and body therapist. Founding member of the 5Elements Collective, developing projects that strengthen young people in artistic contexts.

experiencePartnerships.title: Experience & Partnerships
experiencePartnerships.description: Years of national and international work with cultural institutions, NGOs, companies and educational providers including Goethe-Institut, Amnesty International, PWC, Feierwerk München, and many more.

approachMethod.title: Approach & Method
approachMethod.description: Combines artistic methods with coaching and Somatic Experience. Creates innovative learning spaces focused on creative expression, empowerment, and personal development through authenticity and depth.

visionImpact.title: Vision & Impact
visionImpact.description: Stands for empowerment, creativity, and transformation. Motivates people to be courageous and step out of their comfort zones while creating safe spaces for growth and authentic self-expression.
